<reason>Both sides argued well, but CON built the cleaner decision rule and landed the sharper rebuttals. CON's distinction between intrinsic-act harm (ivory: each purchase kills an elephant) and quantity harm (carbon: aggregate volume does the damage) directly dismantled PRO's best analogy and converted "magnitude is just targeting" into "for atmospheric harm, magnitude is the ethics." CON also set a trap in the opening (the test swallows cruises, jets, ski trips) and PRO half-walked into it by conceding "both can be hard," which CON then used in closing to argue the motion had quietly become "luxury is hard to justify," with the rocket chosen because it is photogenic. PRO's reply — that the motion only requires special hardness, not unique sin — is textually correct and its marginal-tonne reductio ("every luxury tonne becomes easy whenever coal is bigger") was a genuine hit on CON's magnitude frame, so PRO stayed alive. But PRO never neutralized CON's "nobody's ration grows, no household is warmer" pressure beyond asserting scarce atmospheric room, and CON's rejoinder that "buy the instruments" answers a budget question rather than a capability question went comparatively unmet. CON's weakest link — the confident causal chain from a few hundred suborbital joyrides to affordable orbital climate satellites — was attacked only rhetorically ("laundering a joyride through a weather instrument"), not on the suborbital/orbital slippage, so it survived more than it deserved. Pressure rounds favored CON slightly: its exit-condition question forced PRO into a "directional, unnameable" threshold, which CON then combined with PRO's soot concession into a strong "verdict immune to evidence" charge. PRO answered with correct A1:/A2: labels and honest engagement, but also carried an execution cost: its first rebuttal was clipped for exceeding the cap, cutting off the permanent-veto response. Close, competitive, CON edges it.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON's reframing of the ivory analogy — harm intrinsic to the act versus harm defined by aggregate quantity — which turned PRO's strongest illustration into evidence that PRO had borrowed the wrong moral structure, and set up the later "no ledger, nobody's ration grows" weighing.</best_rebuttal>
